data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Add test for DELETE action coverage. (a) test_unauthorized_leaf_must_not_delete_dso_id_label — unauthorized leaf attempts delete on dso-id label → DsoIdLabelWriteError raised. (b) test_inbound_clean_label_may_delete_dso_id_label remains the sole authorized delete path. Update full matrix: each unauthorized leaf gets {create, update, delete} test coverage; authorized leaves (outbound_create for create, inbound_clean_label for delete) get positive tests for their authorized action.
